declarations.docstring: Applying the slot-indexed map to the linear map obtained from a permutation equivalence yields an element of the algebra generated by the specified range.
Every finitely supported family of natural numbers on a finite type is realized as the fiber cardinalities of a map between finite types.
The algebra generated by the range of the distinguished family agrees with the designated subalgebra.
The designated subalgebra is contained in the algebra generated by the range of the distinguished family.
The trace of the matrix built from a permutation, a finite word, and a selected position belongs to the range of the distinguished family.
A weighted homogeneous polynomial in the designated subalgebra belongs to the algebra generated by the range of the distinguished family.
